name: mcp-server-pixeltable-developer
description: Build, inspect, and operate Pixeltable applications from Claude.

project_root.title: Application directory
project_root.description: Directory holding your Pixeltable app.py. Fixed for the life of the server process.

pixeltable_home.title: Pixeltable catalog
pixeltable_home.description: Catalog the server may read and mutate. Use a disposable catalog for evaluation.

tools.name: pixeltable_list_catalog
tools.description: List tables, views, and directories in the local Pixeltable catalog.

tools.name: pixeltable_describe
tools.description: Return schema, computed-column, index, and version metadata for a local table or view.

tools.name: pixeltable_rows
tools.description: Preview up to 100 rows without evaluating unstored computed columns unless explicitly requested.

tools.name: pixeltable_get_row
tools.description: Look up one local table row using primary-key values in declared key order.

tools.name: pixeltable_errors
tools.description: List failed computed-column values for a local table that has a primary key.

tools.name: pixeltable_insert_rows
tools.description: Insert 1 to 1,000 JSON rows into a local table and run its stored computed columns.

tools.name: pixeltable_scaffold_app
tools.description: Initialize the project and write one Pixeltable 0.7 application or brief schema example.

tools.name: pixeltable_schema_check
tools.description: Validate a TableModel schema file without reading or changing a catalog.

tools.name: pixeltable_schema_diff
tools.description: Read the migration plan between a TableModel schema file and a local or hosted target.

tools.name: pixeltable_schema_update
tools.description: Reconcile a TableModel schema against a target.

tools.name: pixeltable_schema_prune
tools.description: Preview or remove target tables that are absent from the TableModel schema.

tools.name: pixeltable_service_check
tools.description: Validate a FastAPIRouter application without changing a catalog or starting a service.

tools.name: pixeltable_service_diff
tools.description: Compare declared FastAPI services with a local or hosted target without changing either.

tools.name: pixeltable_service_update
tools.description: Start or reconcile declared services against a local or hosted target.

tools.name: pixeltable_service_list
tools.description: List services known locally or for one explicit local/hosted target.

tools.name: pixeltable_service_stop
tools.description: Stop one or more named services without removing their configuration.

tools.name: pixeltable_service_prune
tools.description: Preview or remove running services absent from the application file.
